examples.text: 这和大腕儿不大腕儿的没什么关系，你知道我工作从来不迟到，今天真的是第一次，实在不好意思。
examples.trans: Superstar or not has nothing to do with it; you know I am never late for work — today is truly my first time, and I'm terribly sorry.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 今天是十二歌王决赛之夜！
examples.trans: Tonight is the finals night of Twelve Singers!

examples.text: 今天是十二歌王决赛之夜！
examples.trans: Tonight is the finals night of Twelve Singers!

examples.text: 来看你啊！我可是人生第一次尝试传说中的办公室恋爱。
examples.trans: I came to see you! This is my very first time trying out a legendary office romance.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 这次实在是不好意思，让大家久等了。
examples.trans: I am truly sorry this time for keeping everyone waiting.

examples.text: 今天手里的活实在太多了。
examples.trans: There really is too much work on hand today.

examples.text: 再说了，还是跟着淳于总最好。
examples.trans: Besides, working under Chun Yuqiao is still best.

examples.text: 这件事等明天开完会再说吧。
examples.trans: Let us talk about this after tomorrow's meeting.

examples.text: 你病刚好，千万不能生气。
examples.trans: You have only just recovered from illness and must not get angry.

examples.text: 我到车站的时候，地铁刚好进站。
examples.trans: Right when I reached the station, the train pulled in.

examples.text: 王总，开什么玩笑呢？
examples.trans: Director Wang, what kind of joke is this?

examples.text: 王总，开什么玩笑呢？
examples.trans: Director Wang, what kind of joke is this?

examples.text: 我跟他不一样，我要了一个实习生的名额。
examples.trans: I am different from him; I asked for one intern spot.

examples.text: 这是一个。
examples.trans: Translation.

examples.text: 真的没事，再说了，我们刚好给布小谷开一个庆祝会！
examples.trans: Honestly it's fine — besides, we just used the time to throw Bu Xiaogu a promotion party!

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

examples.text: 今天聊得很开心，下次见！
examples.trans: Great chatting today, see you next time!

examples.text: 我们下次见！
examples.trans: See you next time!
